title: FDIC — Understanding Deposit Insurance
excerpt: FDIC deposit insurance covers $250,000 per depositor, per FDIC-insured bank, for each account ownership category. All of your deposits in the same ownership category in the same FDIC-insured bank are added together.

title: FDIC — Deposit Insurance FAQs
excerpt: Deposit insurance is calculated dollar-for-dollar, principal plus any interest accrued or due to the depositor, through the date of default.

title: Marcus — FAQs
excerpt: All loans and deposit products are provided by Goldman Sachs Bank USA, Salt Lake City Branch.
